Re: Withdrawal from Star League — Eben Winny (4th grade)
From: Star League Coordinator <starleague.coordinator@tmsaschools.org>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 17:42:08 -0500

Latest reply (Sat Nov 7, 5:42 PM): Mr. Erdogan replied "Sounds Good. Hopefully he had a better experience." — confirming Eben's move to the easier level went ahead this morning.

Thread summary:
- Oct 31 — Winny sent the withdrawal request for Eben (original email at the foot of the thread).
- Nov 3, 7:25 PM — Coordinator (Muhammed Faik Erdogan) asked whether withdrawal was final, or whether Eben could be placed in an easier class level that might be a better fit. Per policy, no refunds for remaining sessions.
- Nov 4, 8:43 AM — Winny asked what the easier level would look like in practice: which level, how it differs in pace, difficulty of problems, and amount of homework, and how placement is decided. He explained Eben has been finding the class stressful, dreads going, and the pressure is too much right now; if the easier level genuinely takes that pressure off, they are open to it.
- Nov 4, 11:33 AM — Coordinator confirmed a slower-paced track exists that covers the curriculum at a slower pace, and said he was reaching out to Eben's current teacher for input on his progress and to confirm details for the slower-paced option.
- Nov 6, 4:06 PM — Winny confirmed Eben is willing to try the easier, slower-paced class instead of withdrawing completely, and asked for placement details: class day and time, pace and homework expectations, and when he should start.
- Nov 6, 9:09 PM — Coordinator assigned Eben to Room 122. Eben could stay in Ms. Zavooshi's class for the first period to say goodbye and explain the move, or head directly to his new classroom — whichever makes him more comfortable. Both teachers were informed. The schedule is the same for both classes on the same days and time. Homework depends on the teacher.
- Nov 7, 8:26 AM — Winny replied Eben will head straight to Room 122 this morning, and thanked them for the smooth transition.
- Nov 7, 5:42 PM — Coordinator replied "Sounds Good. Hopefully he had a better experience."

# Empneo Ventures LLC — Executive Summary

*The LLC and its Cavli investment, 2019–2026 · Prepared 2026-11-02 from the complete email record (288 messages, all read)*

**The entity.** Delaware LLC (File #7564297), formed August–September 2019 to fund early-stage technology startups. Registered agent: Harvard Business Services, Inc. Bank: First Citizens Bank. Managing Members: Winny Wilson, Bimal Cyriac V, Anil George Thomas. Nine of the eleven named members subscribed capital — **$75,000** in total at $10.00 per Class A unit (Bimal Cyriac and Winny Wilson $13,700 each; seven members $6,800 each; two members nil).

**How the Cavli shares were bought.** Three stages. (1) *Fall 2019* — members fund the LLC's First Citizens account (India-based members remitting via ICICI under the RBI Liberalised Remittance Scheme). (2) *October 25, 2019* — the LLC wires **$68,273** into a SAFE (Simple Agreement for Future Equity, "SAFE1") in Cavli Wireless Inc.; Cavli confirms receipt the same day. (3) *October–November 2022* — in Cavli's restructuring into the new Cavli Inc., the SAFE is terminated (October 6) and exchanged under the A1-03 Share Purchase Agreement (November 8) for **96,478 Series A-1 Preferred shares** at a nominal $0.00001 per share — $0.96 total legal consideration, the real consideration being the surrendered SAFE. **Effective cash cost ≈ $0.7077 per share.** The holding is unchanged since; the record shows no other Cavli instrument, no sale, and no distribution.

**Holding at a glance**

| | |
|---|---|
| Holder | Empneo Ventures LLC |
| Instrument | Series A-1 Preferred Stock, Cavli Inc. |
| Shares | 96,478 |
| Cash invested | $68,273 (SAFE1, 2019) |
| Effective cost | ≈ $0.7077 / share |

**Since the exchange.** 2021 — Cavli moves investor records to Carta. February 2023 — Cavli directs the nominal $0.96 consideration to its Silicon Valley Bank account; SVB fails ten days later and no payment confirmation appears in the record. February 2026 — on member Deepu Zacharia's death, his units transfer to his widow, Ishitha Raman-Zacharia, with a new share certificate. May 2026 — Series A stockholder consent ratifying bridge SAFEs ($3.3M in 2025; $3.5M in 2026 incl. Qualcomm $3M) circulated. October 2026 — **Series B: $29M at a $50M pre-money valuation** (lead Ascent Capital; DEG, Celesta, Chiratae, Qualcomm, Cisco; FY26 revenue $12.4M), in two tranches to December 31, 2026, possibly followed by secondary offers to angel investors. Empneo's Majority Stockholder Consent as an A-1 holder was outstanding on the morning of November 2, 2026, with a call scheduled that day.

**Running costs — Harvard Business Services.** Delaware franchise tax, filing fees and registered-agent service, 2021–2026: **$2,795 in total** (2021: $50 · 2022: $424 · 2023: $641.50 · 2024: $419 · 2025: $641.50 · 2026: $619). Tax years 2021, 2022, 2024 and 2025 are confirmed paid with Delaware acknowledgements; tax years 2019, 2020 and 2023 are not fully evidenced in the record, and the stated tax amounts for 2022, 2024 and 2025 exceed Delaware's $300 flat tax without explanation in the record. Payer-side records show $2,153.50 of the fees was paid on Winny Wilson's personal PayPal/cards; the payer of the remaining $641.50 (2025) is not evidenced, and no reimbursement is evidenced.

**Money position per the record.** $75,000 subscribed less $68,273 invested leaves **$6,727** whose disposition the email record does not evidence ($3,932 if all HBS fees are treated as borne by the pool). Distributions, refunds or returns of capital: **none** in the record.

*Full detail and evidence: Consolidated Report (6 pp.) and Audit Report (23 pp., incl. the complete message inventory), both dated 2026-11-02.*
